flawed_step: 0006: The union of two perfect matchings need not have components that are isolated vertices or cycles. If M and M' share an edge, its two endpoints form an isolated-edge component, not isolated vertices; moreover, vertices are not elements of the edge sets M and M'.
assessment_summary: The proof's central component classification is incorrect as written. Replacing “isolated vertex” with “isolated edge” would repair the argument: every other component is an alternating cycle, which cannot occur in a tree, so all matching edges are shared and M=M'.
